learning_outcomes.text: Understand and utilize the advantages of object-oriented programming.
Define and instantiate classes, create inheritance hierarchies, and use polymorphism to develop flexible and reusable software.
Handle exceptions in Python and develop robust error handling strategies.
Read and write files and use data streams for efficient data processing.
Develop recursive algorithms and use multithreading techniques to parallelize algorithms and improve their runtime.
Use UML diagrams for modeling and planning software projects to visualize the structure and behavior of software components.
Create basic graphical user interfaces and handle user interactions.
Appropriately use data structures such as lists, stacks, and queues for problems.
Assess the efficiency of algorithms and calculate runtime complexities to develop powerful and scalable software solutions.

syllabus_topics: Characteristics of object-oriented programming: classes, inheritance, polymorphism
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded for a passed written exam. There are no prerequisites for participation in the exam.
bibliography: Ernesti, Johannes u. Kaiser, Peter Python 3, Rheinwerk Computing (2023), Also as online resource (5th edition) https://openbook.rheinwerk-verlag.de/python/
